name: GPPO RF Transition Designer
description: Librarian authoring of immutable GPPO RF transition artifacts and recipes
description_full: An independent native KiCad librarian ActionPlugin for reading approved GPPO library footprints, authoring parameterized signal via stacks, layer-specific copper enlargement, antipads and ground-via arcs with validated exit corridors, reopening recipes, cloning variants and publishing immutable revisions. Saves exact declarative board geometry, complete recipes, dependency pins and SHA-256 integrity hashes for offline consumption. Source footprints and placed boards are never edited. This testing prerelease supports KiCad 10.0.0 through 10.0.8; fabrication and RF electromagnetic qualification remain outside the tool.
